text:
Type: metal frame coffee table
Use: holding drinks and decor in front of a sofa; living room
Style: industrial, modern, rustic
Materials: patchwork wood block top in mixed tones, dark metal tube frame
Colors: light natural wood, honey brown, dark gunmetal
Shape: rectangular inset top in a thin open box frame, slim square legs joined by low stretchers, light and open, medium size
Feel: airy, textured, casual
Goes with: leather or canvas sofas, brick or white walls, black metal accents; industrial or loft rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Industrial Coffee Table with Multisquare Wood Design, 47.24"W
product.description: The multisquare wooden plank tabletop creates a natural and textured look that will catch the eye in any space. A bronze frame creates a sturdy base, stable enough for this piece to work wherever you need storage. This unique piece comes fully assembled and has easy care, making it a must-have addition. 47.24"W x 25.59"D x 15.75"H Tabletop made with unique multisquare wood parquetry design inset in a metal base This coffee table is a mix of modern aesthetics and traditional craftwork. The bronze frame has clean lines and modern styling. Fully assembled table No assembly required Clean with a soft, damp cloth. Avoid placing furniture near heat vents or open windows. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
